nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $\sigma$ an index set and $X \subseteq K^\sigma$ a set of points. The affine coordinate ring of $X$ is the quotient $K[x_i : i \in \sigma] / I(X)$ of the polynomial ring over $K$ in variables indexed by $\sigma$ by the vanishing ideal $I(X)$, the ideal of all polynomials that vanish at every point of $X$.
nodes.title: Affine coordinate ring

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $\sigma$ an index set, $X \subseteq K^\sigma$ a set of points and $P \in X$. For every polynomial $f$ over $K$ in variables indexed by $\sigma$, evaluating the residue class of $f$ in the affine coordinate ring of $X$ at $P$ gives $f(P)$.
nodes.title: Evaluating a residue class

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $\sigma$ an index set and $X \subseteq K^\sigma$ a set of points. For a point $P \in X$, evaluation at $P$ is the ring homomorphism from the affine coordinate ring of $X$ to $K$ that sends the residue class of a polynomial $f$ to $f(P)$; it is well defined because every polynomial in the vanishing ideal of $X$ vanishes at $P$.
nodes.title: Evaluation at a point of an affine set

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $\sigma$ an index set and $X \subseteq K^\sigma$ a set of points whose affine coordinate ring $A$ is an integral domain. A rational function on $X$ is an element $r$ of the field of fractions of $A$; it is regular at a point $P \in X$ when there is some $g \in A$ whose value $g(P)$ under evaluation at $P$ is nonzero such that $g r$ lies in the image of $A$ in its field of fractions.
nodes.title: Regularity of a rational function at a point

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $\sigma$ an index set and $X \subseteq K^\sigma$ a set of points whose affine coordinate ring $A$ is an integral domain. For every $a \in A$ and every point $P \in X$, the image of $a$ in the field of fractions of $A$ is a rational function on $X$ that is regular at $P$.
nodes.title: Elements of the coordinate ring are regular

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K$ a nontrivial commutative ring. For every ring homomorphism $\mathrm{ev} : A \to K$ and every $a \in A$, the image of $a$ in the total ring of fractions of $A$ is regular at $\mathrm{ev}$.
nodes.title: Elements of the base ring are regular

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K$ a nontrivial commutative ring. For every ring homomorphism $\mathrm{ev} : A \to K$, the element $1$ of the total ring of fractions of $A$ is regular at $\mathrm{ev}$.
nodes.title: One is regular

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K$ a nontrivial commutative ring. For every ring homomorphism $\mathrm{ev} : A \to K$, the element $0$ of the total ring of fractions of $A$ is regular at $\mathrm{ev}$.
nodes.title: Zero is regular

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $K$ be commutative rings and $\mathrm{ev} : A \to K$ a ring homomorphism. An element $r$ of the total ring of fractions of $A$ (its localization at the non-zero-divisors) is regular at $\mathrm{ev}$ when there is some $g \in A$ with $\mathrm{ev}(g) \neq 0$ such that $g r$ lies in the image of $A$ in its total ring of fractions.
nodes.title: Regularity of a fraction at an evaluation

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
